Example data set

Source: R/data.R
example_data.Rd

This simulated data set can be used to explore the major function of 'specr'. It provides variables that can be used to mimic different independent and dependent variables, control variables, and grouping variables (for subset analyses).

Usage

data(example_data)

Format

A tibble with 1,000 rows and 15 variables (no missing values):

group1

Grouping variable with three groups ("young", "middle", "old"), e.g. for subset analyses.

group2

Grouping variable with two groups ("female", "male").

group3

Grouping variable with three groups ("A", "B", "C").

x1, x2, x3, x4

Numeric variables that can be used as (alternative) independent variables.

c1, c2, c3, c4

Numeric variables that can be used as control variables.

y1, y2, y3, y4

Numeric variables that can be used as (alternative) dependent variables.

Source

Simulated data.

Examples

data(example_data)
head(example_data)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 15
